trailhead.label: Ramoni car park at Còler, upper Val di Rabbi, the board’s start

cautions: The waterfalls path is steep, with spray and wet, slippery steps: the board grades the walk difficult.
In summer the upper Val di Rabbi is closed to cars from 10:00 to 18:00 (27 June to 6 September in 2026): arrive before 10:00 or take the Stelviobus from Rabbi Fonti.
Cows may graze around Malga Stablasolo in summer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
